publication_semantics.core_statement: the same 30 core transects were sampled across three phases; one Faial BALA1 transect FAI-NFCF-T-11 was replaced by FAI-NFCF-TB26 for later phases because Rubus ulmifolius prevented trap installation

audit_questions: How many Event rows remain after restricting to publication-defined phase-specific core site codes?
How are any remaining rows beyond the reported 4929 distributed by site, year, protocol and fieldNumber prefix?
How many duplicate standardized sample slots exist, where a slot is phase + core lineage + samplingProtocol + fieldNumber?
Does the response-independent sample-slot structure explain the residual without using occurrence data?

sample_slot_definition.conceptual_lineage: FAI-NFCF-T-11 in BALA1 and FAI-NFCF-TB26 in BALA2/BALA3 share one lineage; every unchanged code is its own lineage
sample_slot_definition.purpose: audit repeated or enriched Event rows under a standardized campaign; not yet an authorized deduplication rule

anti_selection: do not add or remove site codes to hit 4929
do not choose a fieldNumber prefix because excluding it hits 4929
do not inspect occurrence rows or taxa
do not deduplicate Event rows until a later contract justifies a rule from protocol semantics
